name: Yaotome Iroha
source:
Iroha is another tsundere/sadistic character. She loves to enjoy seeing others suffer mentally, and Zenichi is not an exception. Despite this,  she has a “cute side” that she tries to hide from everyone else… but it appears so easily in front of the protagonist, easily mesmerizing him to this girl who always acts cold. 

She has an obsession for shiratama dango.
